body:
This item is part of Capital Grants 2026. You must read the Capital Grants 2026 guidance to understand the rules and how to apply.

If you’re applying for this item as part of a Countryside Stewardship Higher Tier (CSHT) application, you must read the CSHT applicant’s guide to understand the rules and how to apply.

How much you’ll be paid  

£277.26 once per agreement. 

How this item benefits the environment 

This item allows one member from your holding to get accredited to carry out enhanced educational experiences. 

Where you can use this item  

You can use this item only alongside capital item VED1: Educational access visits . You must apply for both items in the same application. 

What you must do to use this item 

You must send one person from your holding to a Countryside Educational Visits Accreditation Scheme (CEVAS) training course. Read the CEVAS website for more information. 

Evidence you must keep  

You must keep a copy of your accreditation certificate and provide with your claim.

Read the record keeping and site visit requirements in the Agreement holder’s guide: Capital Grants, Higher Tier capital grants and Protection and Infrastructure grants for more information.

If you’re applying for this item as part of a Countryside Stewardship Higher Tier (CSHT) application, you must read the record keeping and site visit requirements in the CSHT agreement holder’s guide.
